exact_answer_quotes.exact_text: `build_thread_count_` comes from `PARAM_DISKANN_BUILDER_THREAD_COUNT` = `"zvec.diskann.builder.thread_count"` (`diskann_builder.cc:51`; `diskann_params.h:31-32`), defaulting to `hardware_concurrency()` when unset (53-55); nothing in the db layer sets it, so here it is ≥ 4. `PqInt8Quantizer::init` stores the param (`src/turbo/quantizer/pq_int8_quantizer/pq_int8_quantizer.cc:142`), and `train_all_chunks` creates a **brand-new** `SingleQueueIndexThreads(thread_count_, false)` — its own owned `ailego::ThreadPool` (`pq_int8_quantizer.cc:321-323`; `index_threads.h:113-116, 166`) — then dispatches PQ chunks round-robin across its `pool_count` workers (328-343, wait at 356).
